Q: The Relict Theory: This view proposes that the X are the last remaining descendants of a widespread Y population that once inhabited northern India and perhaps the Z. In this scenario, they were left behind as other Y speakers were pushed south by incoming A migrations.
The Migration Theory: Conversely, many linguists argue the X migrated north from Central India much later, likely around 1000 CE. This is supported by the fact that X lacks ancient Iranian loanwords it would have acquired had it been in B for millennia, and its grammar shares features with North Y languages like Kurukh.
